verdict: No functional defect found by independent control/liveness review. Hardware timing acceptance remains pending.
allocation_invariants: Private pointer starts at zero and advances only on input_valid && input_ready, wrapping at P-1. Valid tokens carry this private slot; external tags are payload only.
Every compression has the same P*ceil(64/(P*U)) unstalled-edge latency to the feed-forward edge. Partial final rounds bypass data/schedule without changing occupancy or latency.
At most P active tokens occupy the ring. Uniform token latency preserves admission/completion order, so the (n+P)th admission cannot reuse slot n before token n reaches feed-forward.
Same-edge feed-forward and slot reuse read the old CV, then write the new CV through nonblocking clocked updates. The old response afterward resides in output_cv, not the CV bank.

Output backpressure freezes all ring metadata/data and the pointer because stalled forces input_ready low; reset clears valid, return_pending, output_valid and pointer. Stale unreset CV storage is therefore never read by a valid token.
For non-power-of-two P, the explicit P-1 wrap maintains 0 <= pointer < P; only a valid admission pointer or carried valid slot reaches the bank read.
timing_risks: New path: cv_slot[last] -> distributed-bank address decode/read -> eight parallel 32-bit feed-forward additions -> output_cv FF. This path did not exist when full CVs shifted with tokens.
Input CV write-data/write-enable distribution may affect placement. Distributed storage inference and netlist area are tool-dependent.
Same-address reuse is architecturally old-data-before-edge semantics; actual minimum delay/clock skew and setup/hold must be checked in the routed netlist.
A failed target route must not be converted into an inferred Fmax or physical ATP.
recipe_overlap_review: block_tag is retained separately while format_tag reserves the next context. DESCRIBE changes format_cv/address/length only when the prior block is absent or accepted on that same edge.
Block data writes occur only in PREPARE or a retained beat commit. DRAIN commits the last old beat before asserting block_ready; no subsequent prefix/beat write can overlap an unaccepted block.

During list streaming, PREPARE primes the current pair. A missing-list beat captures only current words; an already valid/current beat consumes retained words and fetches following words. list_next_index0 advances the registered endpoint pair one cycle ahead.
At a block boundary list_words_valid is cleared and the next PREPARE primes the block-specific first index; speculative end-of-block addresses do not create a valid stale word.
evidence_scope: Root supplied all30 legalPU normal/SYNTH 181 independent vectors with equal cycle/stall/tag/replay metrics; this review did not rerun or edit RTL.
